title: Forgeline map

kinds.public: a command you type, or a session you start
kinds.lane: a stage or agent the factory runs on its own
kinds.external: a skill or tool from outside this repo (the origin says where)
kinds.hook: a guard that fires on its own

notes: Written from USAGE.md and the factory skill. Source paths are repo-root-relative.

nodes.label: /factory intent
nodes.what: Writes intent.md from a raw idea, ticket or incident, then stops.
nodes.when: You have an idea. /factory <feature> does the same, because intent is required by default.
nodes.how: Creates the job at stage intent and spawns the intent-writer. Only a person's --skip-intent "reason" skips it; the approver then always escalates.

nodes.label: /factory accept
nodes.what: Accepts the intent and starts the spec.
nodes.when: You have read intent.md and answered its open questions.
nodes.how: Rewrites the intent with your answers, creates the branch and worktree, then spawns the spec-writer.

nodes.label: /factory approve-spec
nodes.what: Approves the spec and starts planning.
nodes.when: You have read spec.md and its Risk and Assumptions.
nodes.how: Writes your words and the time to spec-approval.md. A spec with a Split section goes to the split step instead of the planner.

nodes.label: /factory respec
nodes.what: Sends the spec back with a note.
nodes.when: The spec is not right yet.
nodes.how: Saves your note verbatim as spec-feedback-N.md and re-spawns the spec-writer.

nodes.label: /factory approve
nodes.what: Merges a needs-human job.
nodes.when: The approver escalated and you decided it is fine.
nodes.how: Writes human-approval.md and runs the merge gate with the human-approved flag. Never used without this command.

nodes.label: /factory rework
nodes.what: Sends a needs-human job back to the builder.
nodes.when: You want a change before it merges.
nodes.how: Saves your note as rework-N.md and starts a fresh builder with a fresh resume budget.

nodes.label: /factory ready
nodes.what: Starts split children whose dependencies have merged.
nodes.when: A split parent exists, or a child just merged.
nodes.how: Runs jobctl ready --close-parents, creates a worktree and spec for each ready child, and closes a parent whose children all merged.

nodes.label: /factory next
nodes.what: Runs the first unchecked backlog item.
nodes.when: You want the next queued job.
nodes.how: Claims the line in factory/backlog.md with one edit so two sessions never take the same item.

nodes.label: /factory stop | resume
nodes.what: Pauses unfinished jobs and picks them up again.
nodes.when: You are stopping work, or a session limit cut a run off.
nodes.how: Pause stops the next stage from starting; a subagent already running can only be stopped by interrupting the session. Resume continues from the job files.

nodes.label: /factory metrics
nodes.what: Cycle time, first-pass rate, review rounds, escalation rate.
nodes.when: You want to see how the factory is doing.
nodes.how: Runs metrics.py over the job.json files; nothing is stored separately.

nodes.label: /factory lessons
nodes.what: Groups review findings that recur across jobs and suggests a fix for each.
nodes.when: You have several jobs of history.
nodes.how: Reads every CHANGES review, groups near-identical findings seen in at least two jobs, and suggests architecture, types, lint, test or rule, strongest first. You decide; nothing is changed for you.

nodes.label: /factory doctor
nodes.what: Checks that a repo is ready for the factory.
nodes.when: Before the first job, and after any setup change.
nodes.how: Checks AGENTS.md covers setup, tests, build, dev server, layout, conventions and what not to touch, and that policy, hooks, gitignore, helper skills and verify-app are in place.

nodes.label: /factory init
nodes.what: Drafts AGENTS.md (and VERIFY.proposed.md for an app) for a new repo.
nodes.when: The repo has no project doc yet.
nodes.how: Spawns the onboarder. If AGENTS.md exists it writes AGENTS.proposed.md instead; you merge it.

nodes.label: /factory review
nodes.what: Reviews any branch or pull request.
nodes.when: You want a second opinion outside a factory job.
nodes.how: Runs review_branch.py; a read-only agent reviews against REVIEW.md and a script drops comments not on a real diff line. Nothing is posted.

nodes.label: /factory maintain
nodes.what: Runs the maintain loop: collect, run, scan, triage, schedule.
nodes.when: You want to watch the product, not just build features.
nodes.how: Detection is plain statistics; the model only diagnoses and writes. A serious breach becomes an intent that waits for you.

nodes.label: Install
nodes.what: How to put Forgeline in a repository.
nodes.how: Copy .claude/ and factory/, ignore the runtime files, run doctor, set your verify commands, and run the evals.

nodes.label: All 14 agents
nodes.what: Who writes what.
nodes.when: Whenever you want to know which agent owns a file.
nodes.how: Nine agents run the job loop; five sit beside it. Each writes exactly one file and never merges, pushes or deploys.

nodes.label: Guardrails
nodes.what: What stops an agent.
nodes.how: Hooks, the policy file, the weakened-bar scan, secrets checks, the audit trail and the merge gate.

nodes.label: Split jobs
nodes.what: Big work becomes dependent child jobs.
nodes.when: The spec-writer adds a Split section.
nodes.how: Children inherit the accepted intent, wait on their dependencies, and are specced only after those have merged.

nodes.label: Parallel + worktrees
nodes.what: One session per job.
nodes.when: You run several jobs at once.
nodes.how: Each job has its own branch, worktree, ports and browser session, so jobs never touch each other.

nodes.label: Maintain loop
nodes.what: Watches the running product and the repo.
nodes.when: On a schedule, or when you run /factory maintain.
nodes.how: Collects metrics, detects breaches, diagnoses read-only, and scans four lenses. It never merges, deploys or pushes.

nodes.label: Dashboard + metrics
nodes.what: A live board over factory/jobs.
nodes.how: dashboard.html polls every two seconds; metrics and lessons read the same job files.

nodes.label: Evals + CI
nodes.what: Proof that the factory itself still works.
nodes.when: After any change to .claude/ or factory/.
nodes.how: 326 offline checks with no model, 17 live agent cases on fixture repos, and a CI workflow.

nodes.label: intent-writer
nodes.what: Writes intent.md in the originator's own words.
nodes.how: Quotes your words verbatim, marks guesses, lists open questions with suggested defaults, and never designs the solution. Model: sonnet.

nodes.label: spec-writer
nodes.what: Writes spec.md: risk, design, criteria, and a Split when needed.
nodes.how: Reads AGENTS.md, the code, the intent, out-of-scope.md, the glossary and ADRs. Rates Risk high for CI, deploy, money or access. Model: opus.

nodes.label: planner
nodes.what: Writes plan.md. Never edits code.
nodes.how: Cites real source and pinned versions for any API it relies on, labels each safety claim by how far it was checked, and writes PLAN: BLOCKED if the spec needs a frozen path. Model: opus.

nodes.label: builder
nodes.what: Implements the plan and writes build.md.
nodes.when: After PLAN: READY, and again after each CHANGES round.
nodes.how: Named builder-<job-id> so it can be resumed. Works only in the worktree, runs tdd, uses verify-app for UI, ticks the Definition of Done. Model: opus.

nodes.label: reviewer-security
nodes.what: Security lens.
nodes.how: Applies factory/checklists/security.md to the diff: access control, input handling, data exposure, secrets, dependencies, workflow files. Model: opus.

nodes.label: reviewer-ux
nodes.what: Experience lens.
nodes.how: Applies the accessibility checklist (flow) and must open the page in agent-browser when the diff changes what it renders. Has the Skill tool for verify-app. Model: sonnet.

nodes.label: reviewer-ui
nodes.what: Visual lens.
nodes.how: Checks tokens, spacing, contrast and responsive behaviour against the repo's own styles, and opens the page. Model: sonnet.

nodes.label: reviewer-code
nodes.what: Correctness lens.
nodes.how: Checks the diff against the spec and plan, the weakened bar, the Definition of Done ticks, and the performance, observability and testing checklists. Model: sonnet.

nodes.label: approver
nodes.what: The final gate: APPROVE or ESCALATE.
nodes.how: Re-runs a command from build.md, checks the one claim most likely wrong, runs policy_check.py, and ends decision.md with Door, Blast radius and Evidence. Model: opus.

nodes.label: onboarder
nodes.what: Drafts AGENTS.md for an unfamiliar repo.
nodes.how: Reads manifests and config and runs only read commands. Writes UNKNOWN: ask the owner for anything it cannot find. For an app it also drafts VERIFY.proposed.md. Model: sonnet.

nodes.label: pr-reviewer
nodes.what: Reviews any branch or pull request.
nodes.how: Read-only. A script drops any comment whose file, line or quoted code is not in the diff, so an invented comment cannot reach a PR. Model: opus.

nodes.label: diagnoser
nodes.what: Explains a metric breach, read-only.
nodes.how: Checks that the metric measures what the band assumes, then lists competing hypotheses and the evidence that separates them. Model: opus.

nodes.label: scanner-security
nodes.what: Security scan lens.
nodes.how: Tries to disprove each candidate; a script then checks every finding against a real file, line and quoted text. Model: opus.

nodes.label: scanner-quality
nodes.what: Maintainability scan lens.
nodes.how: Looks for swallowed errors, dead code, duplicated logic and untested risky code. Model: opus.

nodes.label: tdd
nodes.what: Red-green-refactor, one vertical slice at a time.
nodes.how: Pinned to one commit and installed by install_helper_skills.py. The builder must call it before its first edit when it is installed.
nodes.author: mattpocock

nodes.label: diagnosing-bugs
nodes.what: Reproduce, minimise, hypothesise, instrument, fix, regress.
nodes.how: Used by the builder for Type: bugfix to build the failing-test feedback loop.
nodes.author: mattpocock

nodes.label: codebase-design
nodes.what: Deep modules with small interfaces.
nodes.when: The plan's interface or module shape is unclear.
nodes.how: Vocabulary for the planner and builder: module, interface, depth, seam.
nodes.author: mattpocock

nodes.label: code-review
nodes.what: Standards and Spec axes for a review.
nodes.how: Applied inside one review; no sub-agents.
nodes.author: mattpocock

nodes.label: grilling
nodes.what: Interview method for open questions.
nodes.how: Used by the orchestrator, never inside a subagent: nobody is there to answer.
nodes.author: mattpocock

nodes.label: agent-browser
nodes.what: Browser automation CLI used with your installed Chrome.
nodes.when: The builder and the UX and UI reviewers look at a page.
nodes.how: Every call passes --session <job-id>-<role> so jobs never share a browser. Install it yourself; pin a version.
nodes.author: vercel-labs

nodes.label: verify-app
nodes.what: Your repo's own account of how to start the app and what each area should show.
nodes.when: Builder and UI reviewers, when it is installed.
nodes.how: Drafted by the onboarder as VERIFY.proposed.md; a person reads it and installs it as .claude/skills/verify-app/SKILL.md. Doctor warns until it exists.

nodes.label: jobctl.py
nodes.what: The only writer of job state.
nodes.how: create, set, bump, pause, resume, active, ready, show. Claims the next job number with a plain mkdir so two sessions never clash.

nodes.label: snapshot_audit.py
nodes.what: Commits the job folder to the job branch.
nodes.how: Copies factory/jobs/<id>/ to factory/audit/<id>/ in the worktree and commits it, so the whole record merges with the change.

nodes.label: policy_check.py
nodes.what: Matches changed files against policy.json.
nodes.when: The approver and the merge gate.
nodes.how: Prints VIOLATION for a frozen path, ESCALATE-TRIGGER for escalate paths, dependency files, size and a weakened bar (suppressions, skipped or deleted tests, stripped assertions).

nodes.label: merge_gate.py
nodes.what: The only route to main.
nodes.how: One lock, ordered checks, a throwaway trial merge, verify and ratchets, then the real merge. Exit codes 0 merged, 3 human, 4 refused, 5 verify failed, 6 lock held, 7 merge failed.

nodes.label: constraints.py
nodes.what: Ratchets: a measured number must not fall.
nodes.how: Runs each merge_policy.constraints command on the merged result and compares with the baseline read from the base checkout, so a branch cannot lower it. Exceptions need an owner and an expiry within a year.

nodes.label: adr.py
nodes.what: Records a merged Design section as an ADR.
nodes.how: Commits docs/adr/NNNN-slug.md when the spec has a real Design section. Turn it off with policy.adr.dir set to an empty string.

nodes.label: doctor.py
nodes.what: Readiness checks.
nodes.how: PASS, WARN or FAIL per check; exit 1 on any FAIL.

nodes.label: lessons.py
nodes.what: Groups repeated review findings.
nodes.how: Word-overlap grouping across CHANGES reviews in jobs and audit copies; suggestions come from a small hint table. Read the groups yourself.

nodes.label: metrics.py
nodes.what: Cycle time and rates.
nodes.how: Computed from job.json history; nothing else is stored.

nodes.label: review_branch.py
nodes.what: Reviews any branch or PR.
nodes.how: Runs the pr-reviewer, validates every comment against the diff, and writes gh-review.sh for you to run. It never posts.

nodes.label: install_helper_skills.py
nodes.what: Installs five pinned MIT skills.
nodes.how: Clones at the commit pinned in helper-skills.json. Read the skills first: they become instructions your agents follow.

nodes.label: managed/install.py
nodes.what: Installs the hooks as managed settings.
nodes.how: Dry run by default, --apply to write. Makes the hooks impossible for a repo writer to disable.

nodes.label: collect.py
nodes.what: Gathers real metric values.
nodes.how: Collectors: a command that prints a number, an HTTP JSON endpoint, a log's error rate, git, or the factory's own cycle time.

nodes.label: detect.py
nodes.what: Tests each metric against its own baseline.
nodes.how: 1 sigma logs, 2 sigma diagnoses, 3 sigma acts. Plain statistics; no model.

nodes.label: scan.py
nodes.what: Runs the four scan lenses.
nodes.how: Security and quality use agents; secrets and dependencies need no model. Every finding is verified against the repo and marked new, recurring or dismissed.

nodes.label: dismiss.py
nodes.what: Dismisses a breach with a reason.
nodes.how: Needs a reason and widens that metric's band.

nodes.label: schedule.py
nodes.what: Prints or installs the cron block.
nodes.how: Runs collect and run hourly, scans weekly and the evals weekly. Tested against a crontab file, not installed.

nodes.label: run_evals.py
nodes.what: 326 offline checks, no model.
nodes.how: Covers config, hooks, managed settings, maintain, scan, the merge gate, scripts and artifact formats. Needs Python 3.12 or newer.

nodes.label: agent_evals.py
nodes.what: 17 live agent cases.
nodes.how: Runs each agent on a fixture repo and checks its output file. About 15 minutes of subscription use; one failure can be a flake, so re-run it once.

nodes.label: factory-evals.yml
nodes.what: Runs the offline evals in CI.
nodes.when: On any change to .claude/, factory/, AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md.
nodes.how: A GitHub Actions workflow on Python 3.12.

nodes.label: Hook: edits
nodes.what: Refuses edits to frozen paths and to tests during a bug fix.
nodes.when: Every Edit or Write inside a factory worktree.
nodes.how: Reads factory/policy.json. Path rules apply only inside worktrees, so you are never blocked in your own checkout.

nodes.label: Hook: commands
nodes.what: Blocks push, deploy, publish, secrets in a commit, and a hand-merge of a factory branch.
nodes.how: Read-only git merge-tree and merge-base are allowed. A person authorises a release by starting Claude Code with FACTORY_RELEASE_AUTHORIZED=1; an inline prefix does not count.

nodes.label: Weakened-bar scan
nodes.what: Flags a quietly lowered quality bar.
nodes.when: Every diff the approver or gate checks.
nodes.how: Added @ts-ignore, eslint-disable, noqa, skipped or deleted tests, stripped assertions. Each is an ESCALATE-TRIGGER, not a failure, so a person decides.

nodes.label: Secrets in commits
nodes.what: Blocks committing secrets.
nodes.how: The bash hook scans staged content for common key formats. It complements a real scanner.

nodes.label: Escalate triggers
nodes.what: What always sends a job to a person.
nodes.when: At the approver and the gate.
nodes.how: CI or deploy config, schema migrations, new dependencies, money, access or identity, a change over the size cap, a waived intent, a weakened bar, a high-risk spec.

nodes.label: Test lock (bugfix)
nodes.what: Tests are frozen after the failing-test commit.
nodes.how: The builder commits a failing test, touches .factory-test-lock, and a hook then refuses test edits, so the code is fixed, never the test.

nodes.label: Release variable
nodes.what: Only a person can authorise a push or deploy.
nodes.how: FACTORY_RELEASE_AUTHORIZED=1 must be in the environment of the session you start; an agent cannot set it for the hook.

nodes.label: Inherited intent
nodes.what: Split children carry the parent's accepted intent.
nodes.how: No waiver is recorded, so the approver does not auto-escalate a child.

nodes.label: Dependency check
nodes.what: A child whose dependency has not merged is refused.
nodes.how: Reads depends_on from job.json and each dependency's stage.

nodes.label: Merge lock
nodes.what: One merge at a time.
nodes.how: A second gate run exits 6; you run it again. Stale after merge_policy.lock_stale_minutes.

nodes.label: Clean main
nodes.what: Main must be on the base branch with no stray changes.
nodes.how: A dirty tree (for example __pycache__ that is not ignored) is refused.

nodes.label: Decision present
nodes.what: APPROVE, or ESCALATE plus a human.
nodes.how: ESCALATE merges only with the human-approved flag, passed only after /factory approve.

nodes.label: Commit pinned
nodes.what: The approval is bound to a commit.
nodes.how: job.reviewed_sha must equal the branch head, or every later commit must touch only the audit folder. A code commit after the review voids the approval.

nodes.label: Policy + intent
nodes.what: Frozen paths, escalate paths, size and intent.
nodes.how: A frozen-path edit is always refused. Escalate paths, dependency files, size over the cap, or a waived intent need a human.

nodes.label: Trial merge
nodes.what: Merge into a throwaway copy of main as it is now.
nodes.how: Catches a branch that merges cleanly but no longer builds against a base that moved.

nodes.label: verify_commands
nodes.what: Your build and tests, on the merged result.
nodes.how: Set merge_policy.verify_commands in policy.json. Empty prints NO VERIFY; require_verify refuses outright.

nodes.label: Real merge
nodes.what: --no-ff merge, then cleanup.
nodes.how: Removes the worktree and branch, sets stage merged, records an ADR. Never pushes.

nodes.label: intent.md
nodes.what: Your words, guesses marked, open questions.
nodes.how: First line INTENT: DRAFT; it is read as accepted once you accept it.

nodes.label: spec.md
nodes.what: Risk, design, requirements, acceptance criteria, optional Split.
nodes.how: Each criterion is one observable behaviour plus how to verify it.

nodes.label: plan.md
nodes.what: Steps, proof, blast radius, rollback.
nodes.how: First line PLAN: READY or PLAN: BLOCKED.

nodes.label: build.md
nodes.what: Evidence for every criterion, the Definition of Done, plan adherence.
nodes.how: First line STATUS: READY or BLOCKED. Rewritten each round with a Log.

nodes.label: review-*.md
nodes.what: One verdict file per reviewer per round.
nodes.how: First line VERDICT: PASS or VERDICT: CHANGES. A review that exists only in a message does not count.

nodes.label: decision.md
nodes.what: APPROVE or ESCALATE, with a merge-danger block.
nodes.how: Door (one-way or two-way), Blast radius, Evidence.

nodes.label: job.json
nodes.what: Stage, round, reviews, history, parent and dependencies.
nodes.how: The dashboard and metrics read it.

nodes.label: policy.json
nodes.what: The rules.
nodes.when: Read by hooks, policy_check and the gate.
nodes.how: frozen_paths, escalate_paths, dependency_files, test_globs, blocked_commands, ticketing, merge_policy, adr. Agents cannot edit it.

nodes.label: Definition of done
nodes.what: A standing bar every job clears.
nodes.when: The builder ticks it; reviewers and approver check it.
nodes.how: Correctness, quality, integration, documentation, ship readiness. Frozen to agents.

nodes.label: REVIEW.md
nodes.what: What counts as Important versus a Nit.
nodes.how: Important blocks; a Nit goes under Notes, at most five.

nodes.label: checklists/
nodes.what: Security, accessibility, performance, observability, testing.
nodes.when: Each reviewer applies the one for its pass.
nodes.how: Short lists; an item the diff does not touch is skipped without comment.

nodes.label: out-of-scope.md
nodes.what: Decisions already made not to build something.
nodes.how: A person adds a line; agents may not.

nodes.label: docs/GLOSSARY.md
nodes.what: The project's terms.
nodes.when: intent-writer, spec-writer and planner read it.
nodes.how: Write one in your repo; it is not part of Forgeline.

nodes.label: docs/adr/
nodes.what: Durable decisions.
nodes.when: Written by the merge gate after a merge.
nodes.how: A real Design section becomes NNNN-slug.md. The spec-writer and planner read them.

nodes.label: constraints.json
nodes.what: Ratchet baselines and exceptions.
nodes.when: Read by the merge gate from the base checkout.
nodes.how: A person raises a baseline; the gate only reports when a number improved.

nodes.label: git worktree
nodes.what: One checkout per job.
nodes.how: <repo>-factory/<job-id> on branch factory/<job-id>. Agents change code only here.

nodes.label: Audit trail
nodes.what: factory/audit/<job-id>/ on the branch.
nodes.how: Committed by snapshot_audit.py so the whole record merges with the change.

nodes.label: backlog.md
nodes.what: Queue for /factory next.
nodes.when: Maintain triage accepts findings into it.
nodes.how: One unchecked line per item.

nodes.label: dashboard.html
nodes.what: The live board.
nodes.how: Polls factory/jobs every two seconds. No build step.

nodes.label: AGENTS.md
nodes.what: Your repo's own instructions.
nodes.how: Setup, tests, build, lint, dev server and port, layout, conventions, what not to touch. The agents carry nothing repo-specific.

nodes.label: incident.md
nodes.what: A serious breach, written up.
nodes.how: Becomes an intent that waits for you.

nodes.label: collectors.json
nodes.what: Where metrics come from.
nodes.how: Commands, HTTP endpoints, log files, git, the factory itself.

nodes.label: findings
nodes.what: Scan results, each verified.
nodes.how: New, recurring or previously dismissed; sorted by severity.

nodes.label: triage
nodes.what: Accept a finding into the backlog, or dismiss it.
nodes.how: Dismiss needs a reason and the finding is not raised again.

nodes.label: Claude session
nodes.what: One Claude Code session per job.
nodes.how: A session orchestrates only the job it started.

nodes.label: Ports + sessions
nodes.what: Builder 5100+10n, ux +1, ui +2.
nodes.how: Each job and reviewer also gets its own agent-browser session.

nodes.label: Slice (child job)
nodes.what: A full job: spec, build, reviews, approver, gate.
nodes.how: Specced against the code as it then is, so it reads the real earlier work and the ADR.

nodes.label: Parent closes
nodes.what: A split parent merges when every child has merged.
nodes.how: The parent builds nothing; its worktree stays as the audit record.

nodes.label: Copy .claude/ + factory/
nodes.what: Put the files in your repo.
nodes.how: Start with an empty factory/jobs/ and an empty backlog.

nodes.label: .gitignore.factory
nodes.what: Lines to add to your .gitignore.
nodes.how: /factory/jobs/, the test lock, __pycache__/. Without __pycache__ ignored the gate sees a dirty tree.

nodes.label: Edit policy.json
nodes.what: Make the rules yours.
nodes.how: escalate_paths, frozen_paths, test_globs and, above all, merge_policy.verify_commands.

nodes.label: Python 3.12+
nodes.what: Needed by the evals and maintain/scan.py.
nodes.how: The system Python 3.9 fails with a SyntaxError in scan.py. uv run --python 3.12 works.

nodes.label: AUDIT.md
nodes.what: What is proven and what is not.
nodes.when: Read it before trusting a part.
nodes.how: Evidence from the offline evals, the live evals and the end-to-end runs.

nodes.label: End-to-end runs
nodes.what: Jobs run on a fixture repo.
nodes.how: Natural jobs, escalate with rework, a split job, UI jobs, and a CHANGES round on a fault-injected defect.

nodes.label: --skip-intent "reason"
nodes.what: The one waiver of the required intent.
nodes.when: You decide the feature is too small for an intent.
nodes.how: The reason is kept in job.json and the approver always escalates a waived intent. Never used on an agent's own judgment.

nodes.label: --ticket KEY
nodes.what: Links the job to a ticket.
nodes.how: Every commit starts with the key. With policy.ticketing.mcp_server set, the ticket is read at the start and the outcome is commented at the end.

nodes.label: --type bugfix
nodes.what: Makes the builder reproduce the bug first.
nodes.how: The builder commits a failing test alone, then the test lock is created so the code is fixed, never the test.

nodes.label: Claim a backlog line
nodes.what: Replaces the exact line with a checked, claimed one.
nodes.how: If the edit fails because the line changed, another session claimed it; the next unchecked item is tried.

nodes.label: human-approval.md
nodes.what: The record of your merge approval.
nodes.how: Your instruction verbatim, the UTC time and the first line and Why of decision.md.

nodes.label: rework-N.md
nodes.what: What you want changed before it merges.
nodes.how: The fresh builder reads it with the existing build.md and every round folder.

nodes.label: jobctl pause
nodes.what: Marks a job paused with its stage and a reason.
nodes.how: The pause stops the next stage from starting; nothing is lost because the stage and files are the state.

nodes.label: jobctl resume
nodes.what: Continues from the stage the job paused at.
nodes.how: spec: spec-writer if spec.md is missing; plan, build, review and approve each pick up from their files.

nodes.label: Gate refuses a paused job
nodes.what: A paused job cannot merge.
nodes.how: Resume it first.

nodes.label: A running subagent
nodes.what: Stop pauses the next stage only.
nodes.how: Interrupt the session to stop it. Also what happens when the subscription session limit cuts a run off: resume from the files.

nodes.label: Intent template
nodes.what: The sections the intent-writer fills.
nodes.how: In the originator's words, assumptions, open questions, success criteria. First line INTENT: DRAFT.

nodes.label: Open questions
nodes.what: Every gap a product owner must fill, phrased to answer in a line.
nodes.how: A suggested default in brackets when there is an obvious one; you answer in the file or in chat.

nodes.label: Assumptions (guess)
nodes.what: Anything the intent-writer inferred, marked (guess).
nodes.how: Kept apart from what you actually said so a guess is never read as a requirement.

nodes.label: Claim a job number
nodes.what: Takes the next 3-digit job number with a plain mkdir.
nodes.how: If another session wins the race it retries, so two sessions never share a number.

nodes.label: Risk
nodes.what: The Risk section: low, medium or high with one line of reason; high for CI, deploy, money, access or data migration.
nodes.how: Written by the spec-writer; you approve the whole file.

nodes.label: Context
nodes.what: The Context section: where this lives in the codebase, with paths.
nodes.how: Written by the spec-writer; you approve the whole file.

nodes.label: Design
nodes.what: The Design section: decision, two named alternatives, consequences, interfaces; becomes an ADR after merge.

views.title: Forgeline
views.caption: A software factory for Claude Code. One job runs from idea to main with two human gates; open any area for its agents, files, scripts and guardrails.

nodes.when: Every job starts here unless intent is waived.
nodes.how: intent-writer writes intent.md in your own words, with guesses marked and open questions listed. You answer them and accept.

nodes.label: Spec
nodes.what: Turns the intent into a spec you approve.
nodes.how: spec-writer writes risk, design and testable acceptance criteria, and a Split section for work too big for one change. A human gate follows.

nodes.label: Plan
nodes.what: Writes the plan before any code.
nodes.how: planner reads the real code and writes ordered steps, a proof for each criterion, the blast radius and the rollback.

nodes.label: Build
nodes.what: Implements the plan in the job's worktree.
nodes.how: builder works test-first, ticks the Definition of Done, observes the real artifact, and commits. It is resumed when reviewers return CHANGES.

nodes.label: Review
nodes.what: Four lenses review the branch in parallel.
nodes.how: security, ux, ui and code reviewers each write one file. The round is done only when all four exist.

nodes.label: Approve
nodes.what: Decides whether the branch merges.
nodes.how: approver tries to disprove its own decision, then writes APPROVE or ESCALATE with a merge-danger block.

nodes.label: Merge gate
nodes.what: The only way a job reaches main.
nodes.how: merge_gate.py checks the decision, the pinned commit, policy and dependencies, proves the merge on a throwaway copy, then merges. It never pushes.

views.title: Intake · idea → accepted intent
views.caption: Intent is required by default. You answer the open questions, then accept.

views.title: Spec · design the change
views.caption: The spec-writer proposes; you approve. A big spec adds a Split section.

views.title: Plan · before any code
views.caption: The planner reads real code and cites real source; claims are labelled by how far they were checked.

views.title: Build · in the job's worktree
views.caption: Test first, observe the real thing, tick the Definition of Done, commit. Resumed on CHANGES, at most twice.

views.title: Review · four lenses in parallel
views.caption: Each reviewer writes one file. The round is done only when all four exist; a reviewer that returns without its file is re-spawned once.

views.title: Approve · try to disprove first
views.caption: APPROVE merges with no human looking; ESCALATE stops at needs-human.

views.title: Merge gate · merge_gate.py <job-id>
views.caption: The only way to main. Checks run in order inside one lock; nothing is pushed.

views.title: Split jobs · big work → child jobs
views.caption: A split parent builds nothing; children run in dependency order and each is a full job.

views.title: Parallel jobs + git worktrees
views.caption: One session per job in the same repo; jobs never touch each other and merges are serialised.

views.title: All 14 agents
views.caption: Nine run the job loop (four of them reviewers); five sit beside it. Each writes exactly one file.

views.title: Guardrails
views.caption: Hooks prevent, scans detect, the audit trail records, and the merge gate is the only way to main.

views.title: Maintain loop · watch, diagnose, scan
views.caption: Detection is plain statistics. The model only explains a breach and writes it up; a person decides.

views.title: Dashboard + metrics
views.caption: dashboard.html, metrics and lessons all read the same job files.

views.title: Evals + CI
views.caption: Offline checks need no model; live cases run each agent on a fixture repo; end-to-end runs are recorded in AUDIT.md.

views.title: Install in a repo
views.caption: Copy, ignore the runtime files, run doctor, make the policy yours, then run your first job.

views.title: reviewer-ui

views.title: Commands · everything you can type
views.caption: Three starts a job, two decide, the rest queue, look, set up and watch. Open one for what it runs.

views.title: /factory <feature>
views.caption: Runs a new job. Intent is required, so it starts at intent; only a person can waive that.

views.title: /factory intent
views.caption: Writes intent.md and stops. You answer the open questions, then accept.

views.title: /factory accept
views.caption: You answer, the intent is rewritten, the worktree is created and the spec starts.

views.title: /factory approve-spec
views.caption: Approval is recorded, then the job goes to planning, or to the split step when the spec has a Split section.

views.title: /factory respec
views.caption: Sends the spec back with your note, saved verbatim.

views.title: /factory approve
views.caption: Merges a needs-human job as it is. Only this command lets the gate use the human-approved flag.

views.title: /factory rework
views.caption: Sends a needs-human job back to the builder with a fresh resume budget.

views.title: /factory next
views.caption: Runs the first unchecked backlog item, so two sessions never take the same one.

views.title: /factory ready
views.caption: Starts the split children whose dependencies have merged, and closes a parent whose children all merged.

views.title: /factory stop | resume
views.caption: Stop pauses the next stage; resume continues from the job files.

views.title: /factory metrics
views.caption: Everything comes from the job files.

views.title: /factory lessons
views.caption: Turns repeated mistakes into checks. You decide what to build.

views.title: /factory review
views.caption: Reviews any branch or pull request; read-only.

views.title: /factory doctor
views.caption: Fix every FAIL before the first job.

views.title: /factory init
views.caption: Drafts the project doc; it runs read-only commands only.

views.title: /factory maintain collect | schedule | run | scan | triage
views.caption: Watches the running product and the repo. It never merges, deploys or pushes.
